description_ko: 가위의 두 칼날과 힌지가 머리 자체가 된 키 큰 2족 정원 기계. 가느다란 두 다리, 빈 도구 손, 좁은 꽃 유리함으로 추적자 실루엣을 만든다.

references.role: Initial generation identity, gardening motifs, palette and clean 2D rendering reference only; no head/body/pose lock
Initial generation open shell, winding construction and material reference only; no proportions lock

visual_qa.silhouette: Very tall lean biped, exactly two planted feet and two long arms with empty three-finger tool hands. No four-legged anatomy. One shear-pair mechanism, two upright blades and one brass pivot form the entire head.
visual_qa.head: One targeted edit removed the small ordinary doll face and curls below the pivot. Final blade/pivot assembly connects directly to the slim neck. A small teal pivot cover recalls the cap without a separate human head.
visual_qa.identity: One blue flower with a green stem in the brass-capped chest glass cylinder; teal split apron-leaf panels, ivory/brass materials, compact attached winding drum and one curved teal ribbon retained.
visual_qa.framing: Both blade tips, ribbon, fingers, two feet and all joints are inside the image. Head upper margin is narrow but uncut.
visual_qa.mechanics: Two head blades join the same visible hinge. No second handheld scissors, no detached props or disconnected limbs.

limits: Single-view 2D concept candidate, not selected; no Tripo reconstruction, multi-view consistency, mesh fitting or rig tested.

references.role: Exact initial generated image as sole edit target; remove only ordinary small face/hair and connect shear-head hinge directly to neck

refinement.change: Remove regular girl face under scissor head pivot; preserve every other major shape
